name: talentsia-do
description: Talentsia Do clarifies commitments, next actions, and follow-up in English or Portuguese.

interface.longDescription: Talentsia Do helps clarify inputs, define accepted outcomes and next actions, track delegated results, and review commitments in English or Portuguese. The commitment owner decides; the system steward maintains the record. Personal context stays in your own storage. Requires tools and permissions supplied by the host; includes no storage service, autonomous worker, or scheduled reviews.
defaultPrompt: Use Talentsia Do to clarify my inbox.
Use Talentsia Do to review my active projects.
